india.one_line: MeitY questions home services platforms on in-home AI data collection while new investments target data centres and startups.

themes.title: MeitY questions in-home video data collection
themes.text: MeitY convened a consultation with home services platforms and robotics companies to examine in-home video footage collection by gig workers for training physical AI models, questioning them on consent, privacy, and data-sharing contracts.

stories.headline: MeitY questions home services platforms over in-home video data collection for AI

themes.title: ReNew pledges ₹80,000 crore for AI infrastructure
themes.text: ReNew Energy Global announced an investment of approximately ₹80,000 crore in Andhra Pradesh to build a 1 GW green hyperscale data centre and clean energy manufacturing facilities for AI infrastructure.

stories.headline: ReNew pledges ₹80,000 cr for green data centre and manufacturing in Andhra Pradesh

themes.title: Norwest closes $4 billion fund for AI
themes.text: Norwest closed a $4 billion fund to invest in early-stage and growth AI ventures across India, the United States, and Israel, targeting sectors including physical AI and voice AI.

stories.headline: Norwest closes $4 billion fund to back AI startups in US, India and Israel

themes.title: NITI Aayog warns of AI capital concentration
themes.text: NITI Aayog distinguished fellow Debjani Ghosh warned that the concentration of capital, influence, and circular financing among a handful of companies creates systemic risks and weakens competition.

stories.headline: Niti Aayog's Debjani Ghosh warns AI risk lies in capital and power concentration
